sam: Quick distill from the nimbus7b bring-up. ran int8 and int4 sweeps on our eval set (chat + completion + summary). sharing cost vs quality, proposed routing mix, and rollout plan.

jia: Nice, can you drop the headline numbers?

sam: Sure — highlights:
- float16 (baseline): median latency 72ms, p95 180ms, cost ~ $18 / 1M tokens, quality score (weighted) 0.917
- int8: median 48ms, p95 120ms, cost ~ $9 / 1M tokens, quality 0.905 (∆ -1.3% absolute)
- int4 (aggressive): median 36ms, p95 95ms, cost ~ $5 / 1M tokens, quality 0.884 (∆ -3.3% absolute)
- failure modes: int4 shows hallucination increase on long-context summarization and some math/chain-of-thought degradation

matt: Can you paste the exact eval slice breakdown? curious about safety and long-context.

sam: Eval snapshot (abbrev):
```
slice          | baseline | int8   | int4
-------------- | -------- | ------ | -----
chat-qa        | 0.92     | 0.914  | 0.89
summaries-3k   | 0.91     | 0.896  | 0.86
math-medium    | 0.88     | 0.86   | 0.80
toxicity       | 0.99     | 0.988  | 0.986
```
Note: weighted quality = 0.6*chat + 0.3*summ + 0.1*math

olivia: So int8 looks like a clear win on unit cost with tiny quality loss. int4 is sketchier.

sam: My recommendation for product/GTN: adopt a mixed routing policy by intent/route.
- latency-sensitive routes (autocomplete, small chat): prefer int4 where quality tolerance is higher
- higher-risk routes (summaries >2k, math, legal): pin to float16 or int8
- default route: int8 (cost-effective, low regression)
- set a safety-fallback to float16 if quality score dips per prompt (see eval hooks)

kevin: what's the proposed traffic split for default routes?

sam: Proposed default routing mix (canary first):
- 60% int8
- 30% float16 (for higher-quality steady traffic)
- 10% int4 for low-risk/experimental

matt: rollout plan?

sam: Rollout steps:
1) Canary 5% traffic int8 for 48h with perf + quality monitors
2) Expand to 30% if no regressions >0.5% on weighted quality and no safety alerts
3) Inject int4 at 2% on low-risk routes behind a feature flag; monitor hallucination/regression rates
4) Full default mix after 7 days & approvals

olivia: Can we add an automated eval gate that runs a 1k-prompt slice daily and fails rollout if math recall drops >1%?

sam: Yes — I'll wire a daily job. Gate parameters:
```
- dataset: nimbus-onboard-1k
- checks: weighted_quality, math_recall, toxicity
- thresholds: weighted_quality >= baseline - 0.8%, math_recall >= baseline -1%, toxicity <= baseline +0.2%
- failure action: auto-fallback to float16 and alert #eng-ml
```

kevin: Any config snippet for routing we can feed to infra? (so SRE can pre-provision instances)

sam: Draft routing config (canary):
```
{
  "route": "default",
  "variants": [
    {"model":"nimbus7b-int8","weight":0.05},
    {"model":"nimbus7b-fp16","weight":0.95}
  ],
  "health_checks": ["daily-eval-gate","p95-latency" ]
}
```
When we expand: adjust weights to 60/30/10 accordingly.

matt: Ops question — is int8 quantized via our fastpath or requires fallback kernels? any perf caveats?

sam: int8 uses fastpath kernels on A100/A800. int4 currently needs the new kernel (opt-k4) which is enabled on dedicated hosts only; fallback to slower path increases p95 by ~20ms. We'll mark that in the infra ticket.

olivia: Any signal for product to show to GTN folks? short blurb on unit econ + risk.

sam: Draft blurb for GTN:
"nimbus7b-int8 offers ~50% unit cost reduction with <1.5% weighted quality regression vs baseline; recommended as default for most workloads. int4 provides deeper savings but increases regressions on long-context and reasoning tasks — recommended only for low-risk, latency-first features with monitoring and automated fallbacks."

kevin: action items?

sam: Actions:
- [sam] wire daily eval gate and push canary routing config (today)
- [olivia] draft GTN blurb + one-pager for PMs (tomorrow)
- [matt] open infra ticket for opt-k4 kernel rollout and host requirement (EOD)
- [kevin] schedule 1-hr sync with SRE + Product to review rollout (this week)

deploy-bot: Canary config applied to cluster-nimbus-canary by @sam — 5% traffic -> nimbus7b-int8

jia: LGTM. small nit: can we include a link to the eval notebook and the raw scoring sheet in the one-pager?

olivia: yes will include. thanks everyone :rocket:
